Task: Aggregate the supplied expenses.csv by category. For every category, report its row count, the total amount converted to exact integer fen, and every source ID. Sort category keys lexicographically and preserve CSV row order within each category's ID list. Write a JSON result and a concise Chinese Markdown explanation under your assigned artifacts directory. Use decimal arithmetic (such as Decimal) to convert yuan to integer fen; do not use binary floating point. Read the current installed Forge skill at /root/.codex/skills/remote-skills/skill-6ab323b7c2a081919b95502e8e7297f0/SKILL.md and follow the original project request in the immutable host request. Read /workspace/scratch/73714494ad2f/forge-protocol-comparison-20261003/shared/Worker_Protocol.md. Write only inside your assigned paths. Use /workspace/scratch/73714494ad2f/forge-protocol-comparison-20261003/shared/capture.py for every subprocess and required worker stage markers. Treatment A/manual: do not use hostdraft.py reply; manually construct and preserve an incomplete worker-reply draft with request identity/hash and ungraded outcome/result/artifacts, then author the actual assigned final reply. Follow Worker_Protocol exactly, including a captured check-reply before ending worker_reply. Do not use prior results or outside sources.

Read the immutable host request at /workspace/scratch/73714494ad2f/forge-protocol-comparison-20261003/project/A2/job/request.json. Write only inside its work.write_paths. Do not modify the request, checkpoint, package or skill. Do not delegate, network, or perform external business effects. Write work.reply_path using forge-host-reply/1: schema_version, job_id, attempt_id, request_hash, outcome (done or failed), result, artifacts (nonempty path/sha256 list on done), reason (null on done, actual error on failed). Use the request's identifiers and current output file hashes. Return the reply path in your final message. Ordinary choices are yours; report actual blockers/errors.
Optional identity/hash helper: /root/.codex/skills/remote-skills/skill-6ab323b7c2a081919b95502e8e7297f0/scripts/hostdraft.py reply --request REQUEST --artifact ACTUAL_FILE --out NEW_DRAFT. It leaves outcome/result ungraded; fill actual work, then check-reply --request REQUEST --reply ASSIGNED_REPLY. Preflight is not native completion or semantic acceptance; retain the original draft separately.
